Field
Description
AuditKeyValues.Key and
AuditKeyValues.ValueString
AuditKeyValues come in pairs (Key & ValueString). Possible values for AuditKeyValues.Key include:
actorUser: Name of the user carrying out the operation.
actorCID: Home CID of the user carrying out the operation.
actorUserUUID: UUID of the user carrying out the operation.products: When granting or revoking
subscriptions, the name of the product that was granted or revoked.
roles: When granting or revoking roles, the name of the role that was granted or revoked.
targetCID: Target CID of the operation.target
Username: Name of the target user.targetUserUUID: UUID of the target user.
OperationName
This field describes the Authentication operation:
activateUser: User account was (successfully/not successfully) activated.
changePassword: User password was (successfully/not successfully) changed.
confirmResetPassword: User password was (successfully/not successfully) reset.
createUser: New user account (successfully/not successfully) created.
deactivateUser: User account was (successfully/not successfully) deactivated.
deleteUser: User account was (successfully/not successfully) removed
grantUserRoles: User account was granted a new role.
grantCustomerSubscriptions: User was granted a new subscription.
requestResetPassword: User requested password reset.
resetAuthSecret: User requested Auth Secret reset.
revokeUserRoles: User has a role revoked.
revokeCustomerSubscriptions: User had a subscription revoked.
selfAcceptEula: User accepted Eula.
twoFactorAuthenticate: User account was (successfully/not successfully) authenticated using two-factor
authentication.
updateUser: User details (for example, the user's name) was (successfully/not successfully) updated.
updateUserRoles: User's role was (successfully/not successfully) updated.
userAuthenticate: User account was (successfully/not successfully) authenticated.
ServiceName
CrowdStrike Authentication
UserId
User that performed the operation, for example person that performed the operation to create a new user
account.
UserIp
IP address of user that performs the operation.
UTCTimestamp
Time when the operation took place in Unix epoch time.
